card: Adds functional test coverage for TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication in feature_torcontrol.py. The node's SAFECOOKIE authentication handling previously lacked functional test coverage, risking undetected regressions in Tor control connection management. Tests exercise both successful authentication flows and failure handling for invalid nonces, corrupted server hashes, failed challenge responses, and invalid cookie files.
changed_since_previous: None; the diff matches the previous description.
evidence: Author note in description: 'while working on #35292, i realised we did not have coverage for SAFECOOKIE authentication either, so i added it here'
problem: TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication has no automated functional test coverage, allowing protocol regressions or errors in Tor controller communication to go undetected.

risk.why: Only modifies functional test code in test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py.

summary: Adds functional test coverage for TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication in feature_torcontrol.py. A mock Tor control server tests successful authentication handshakes as well as error handling for challenge failures, invalid server nonces, mismatched server hashes, and missing or short cookie files.
